name: GeO2
notes: Imported 12.08.2026 from a beamline jcpds collection. Source file(s): JCPDS/dac_user_jcpds/GeO2-rutile.jcpds. Ambient rutile-type structure: Haines et al., Physics and Chemistry of Minerals 27, 575-582 (2000).

eos_records.label: Rutile GeO2, Hazen and Finger (1981)
eos_records.notes: Hazen and Finger report K0 = 258 +/- 5 GPa assuming K0' = 7.0 for rutile-type GeO2. The unsupported legacy value K0 = 395 GPa attributed to Yamanaka and Ogata was removed.
